stages.name: Demultiplexing
stages.goal: Convert raw BCL base calls into per-sample FASTQ files.

tools.label: BCL Convert
tools.summary: Illumina's demultiplexer. Splits reads by index into one FASTQ set per sample.

params.label: Merge lanes
params.help: Write one FASTQ per read instead of one per lane.

stages.name: Read quality control
stages.goal: Check base quality, adapter content and duplication before alignment.

tools.label: FastQC + MultiQC
tools.summary: FastQC on every file, then MultiQC rolls the reports into one page.

tools.label: FastQC only
tools.summary: One report per FASTQ file, no aggregate view.

stages.name: Alignment and cell calling
stages.goal: Map reads to the reference and build a gene-by-cell count matrix.

tools.label: STARsolo
tools.summary: Splice-aware alignment with Cell Ranger–compatible barcode and UMI handling.

tools.label: kallisto | bustools
tools.summary: Alignment-free pseudoalignment. Faster and lighter, but no mapped reads (BAM).

stages.name: Ambient RNA removal
stages.goal: Remove background transcripts from lysed cells that leak into every droplet.

tools.label: SoupX
tools.summary: Estimates contamination per sample and subtracts it. Uses STARsolo's cell calls.

params.label: Contamination fraction
params.help: Used only when automatic estimation is off.

tools.label: CellBender
tools.summary: Deep generative model that removes ambient RNA and calls cells itself. GPU recommended.

stages.name: Cell quality filtering
stages.goal: Drop low-quality cells: empty, dying or damaged barcodes.

tools.label: Seurat
tools.summary: Filters on genes per cell, UMIs per cell and mitochondrial fraction.

params.label: Keep genes seen in at least

tools.label: Scanpy
tools.summary: The same filters in Python, with an AnnData hand-off back to Seurat.

params.label: Keep genes seen in at least

stages.name: Doublet removal
stages.goal: Remove droplets that captured two cells.

tools.label: scDblFinder
tools.summary: Simulates artificial doublets per sample and classifies each droplet.

params.label: Expected doublet rate
params.help: Leave empty to use scDblFinder's estimate from cells loaded (≈1% per 1,000).

stages.name: Normalization
stages.goal: Correct for sequencing depth per cell and pick highly variable genes.

tools.label: Seurat
tools.summary: NormalizeData → FindVariableFeatures → ScaleData, per sample layer.

stages.name: Integration, clustering and UMAP
stages.goal: Build the neighbor graph, find clusters and lay out a publication-ready UMAP.

tools.label: Seurat
tools.summary: RunPCA → IntegrateLayers → FindNeighbors → FindClusters → RunUMAP → JoinLayers.

tools.label: Scanpy
tools.summary: PCA → Harmony → neighbors → Leiden → UMAP in Python.

stages.name: Cell type annotation
stages.goal: Give every cluster a biological identity.

tools.label: Seurat markers (manual)
tools.summary: FeaturePlot of canonical markers on the UMAP; you assign labels per cluster.

params.label: Marker genes
params.default: IL7R, CCR7, CD8A, GNLY, NKG7, MS4A1, CD79A, CD14, LYZ, FCGR3A, FCER1A, PPBP

tools.label: CellTypist (automatic)
tools.summary: Logistic-regression classifier trained on reference atlases, with majority voting.

stages.name: Differential expression
stages.goal: Compare conditions within each cell type using pseudobulk replicates.
inputs: Raw counts per cell type and sample
outputs: DE tables (log2 fold change, adjusted p-value)

tools.label: AggregateExpression + DESeq2
tools.summary: Sums raw counts per cell type and sample, then tests condition with DESeq2.

params.markers: IL7R, CCR7, CD8A, GNLY, NKG7, MS4A1, CD79A, CD14, LYZ, FCGR3A, FCER1A, PPBP
